characters.name: The Main Group
characters.description: The title character is the Assistant Director of Personnel at Winifred-Louder, a department store. Much likeDilbert(and just to hammer the point home, Drew is aDilbertfan) he must constantly contend with nutty bosses, strange friends, and unsuccessful romances. Acrofatic: He's no athlete but he's spry and active for his size. Especially apparent during the numerous dance numbers. Allegedly Dateless: He's given lots of flak for supposedly being a failure with the ladies. Granted, his relationships always end in disaster, but he has at least one per season, which is more than can be said for some of his friends. Beware the Nice Ones: Despite his general milquetoast demeanor, he displayed several moments of impressive courage throughout the series, the first being in season one when he stood up to Kate's domineering ex-boyfriend, Barry, and also when he beat up the stalker of his ex-girlfriend Wendy. Big Eater: You can count the episodes that don't mention his eating habits on one hand. He once brags about putting a buffet out of business, and he orders so much pizza that he's gotten multiple delivery boys through college!

characters.name: Recurring Characters
characters.description: All Take and No Give:Downplayed. Drew doesa lotfor him: getting him a job, giving him a home,putting up with Mimi... in fact, Drew is thereason Steve's son was born(granted, Steve had no way to know about that). But the elder Carey rarely supports his kid brother in return and imposes himself in Drew's life. That said, hedoessave Drew from a felony rap, which goes a long way towards making them even. Baldness Mockery: When you're the only bald major character on aSitcomin the 90s, well... it's to be expected. Big Brother Bully: He was a bit of this in his youth. He and Drew get along much better as adults. The Bus Came Back: Season 9's "Love, Sri Lankan Style", where his marriage to Mimi ends for good. Camp Straight: Even without the cross-dressing angle, he's generally meek and sensitive. But he confirms multiple times he's not gay.

characters.name: Winfred Louder
characters.description: Actually Pretty Funny: A big reason why Drew and Mimi's fighting and pranks never get them in trouble at work is because Wick finds it all rather hilarious. He's actually rather disappointed and disturbed by those rare occasions where they get along. Addled Addict: Has a significant arc where he develops a cocaine habit, yo-yos on alcoholism, and finally has to go to rehab. He also has a "passion for ponies" that led him to garnish his wages and put them in a trust so he's not tempted. A slightActor Allusion, since Craig Fergusion struggled with alcoholism himself. Bad Boss: What he was flanderized into. Besides becoming more cartoonish in general, he'd abuse and fire subordinates just for the hell of it and often didn't seem to have the slightest idea how to do his job. Berserk Button: Donotmess with his mummy. British Stuffiness: He has an extremely over the top English accent and is a complete jackass.
